_comment: What scripts/sync-youtube.mjs reads from YouTube. Every public playlist of a channel under `sources` becomes a series, in playlist order: make a playlist on YouTube and it shows up on ORIGINAL after the next sync (Shorts and long-form are told apart by the videos). Every channel under `channels` is named by its YouTube id (UC…, which survives a renamed handle) and gets its name, handle and counts read for the home. `exclude` hides a playlist or video by id. `overrides`, keyed by playlist id, can set `slug`, `cover`/`coverWidth` (a file under public/) and `featured: true`. A source can also take `uploads: true` (uploads in no playlist; titles like 'EP.01 | Name' group under Name) or `videos: [ids]`.
